To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the EORTC Communication-Specific Module (EORTC-COM) is a reliable and valid instrument that can be used to evaluate communication in cancer care.

(i) the majority of patients and their relatives want to know their cancer diagnosis; (ii) patients and their relatives prefer to be told the diagnosis by a physician, and (iii) the majority of the physicians believe that they should inform patients of the cancer diagnosis and that patients should be told by them, although a substantial proportion of them do not inform their patients of the cancer.

we have shown that the EORTC QLQ-ELD13 is an important and useful instrument to assess communication in cancer care and that we have developed a new module for the QLQ-C30 that will be used for future research and clinical practice.
